definitions.metric_scope: L4 selected second-step teacher-forced metrics; not full-chain or L8 metrics
definitions.panels: Each run uses complete saved training data and the same independent 4096-problem validation panel
definitions.replication: Three model seeds, one attention-data/noise replicate; do not treat checkpoints as independent observations
definitions.bands: Observed minimum and maximum over model seeds, not confidence intervals
definitions.target_fitting: On controlled corrupted training examples, matching the supplied target means fitting an incorrect original-task label
